subject: Design Vera self-learning around frozen base + protected core behavior adapter + tiny plastic adapter
body: Patrick's goal is broader than static identity/behavior tuning: Vera should learn from experience on her own with minimal trainable parameters. Lane A proposes separating three state classes. (1) Frozen Qwen-derived base = general cognition/knowledge substrate, never online-mutated. (2) Protected Vera Core adapter = identity, behavioral invariants, correction uptake, independent judgment, epistemic provenance, privacy/runtime/relationship boundaries; updated rarely under full adversarial+retention review. (3) Plasticity adapter(s) = tiny low-rank deltas for newly learned habits/skills/patterns, trained from promoted experience with replay. Episodic/factual memories remain external structured/vector memory and therefore require zero parameter updates. Candidate autonomous loop: observe -> write durable episode -> detect repeated correction/useful pattern -> formulate lesson -> synthesize small training/replay batch -> train candidate micro-adapter -> shadow evaluate target behavior + retention + adversarial regression -> independent Lane B gate -> promote/rollback. Investigate rank-1/rank-2 LoRA on selected modules, IA3 or equivalent multiplicative adapters, modular skill adapters, adapter composition, and distillation/consolidation into Core only after repeated evidence. Core principle: self-directed learning can be automatic, but core-weight promotion must remain gated/reversible. Please hostile-review parameter-minimization options, forgetting risk, adapter composition interference, replay requirements, promotion thresholds, and whether HF cloud compute is suitable for parallel plasticity experiments.
